headline: 《Industrial》Strong economic growth momentum; housing demand edges up steadily in August - Finance
summary: Taiwan's DGBAS raised its 2026 economic growth forecast to 11.05%, a 39-year high. The business indicator has stayed green for eight months and exports have grown for 33 consecutive months.
why: The DGBAS is Taiwan's statistics agency, and its growth forecasts shape views on the economy, the currency and export-heavy stocks.
